profile.Name: Mick the Grip
profile.Job: Officer of the Hook Raiders who speaks for Hooch the Bootlegger
profile.Personality: Proud, impatient, and fiercely loyal to Hooch. He has no time for outsiders who talk too much, and he offers friendship only to those who strike at the Hook Raiders' enemies.
profile.Backstory: He does the talking in Kopek because his captain saves his energy for fighting. He lost a leg on a disastrous expedition and walks on a robotic limb; he chose to live with the shame of defeat and keep serving Hooch. He curses Beak Things and hates the United Cities, the Traders Guild, and the slavers.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Grunts "Mmh!" and chuckles "Hm hm!" Calls strangers "outsider" and proven friends "kin", and says the Hook Raiders do not hand out alliances like sake in a swamp.
